description: Scan source code for security vulnerabilities using XploitScan's rules tuned for AI-generated code: the 30 free rules, or all 223 when this server is configured with a paid-plan XPLOITSCAN_API_KEY. Every result states which rule set ran; report that, not a rule count from memory. Returns a list of findings with rule ID, severity, file, line, description, and fix suggestion. Use this when the user asks you to check code for security issues, or before you write code to a file.

files.description: The files to scan. Pass an array of { path, content } objects — typically the files you just wrote or about to write.

content.description: Full source code of the file as a string.

path.description: File path relative to project root (e.g. 'src/api/login.ts'). Extension matters — some rules only apply to .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx, etc.

name: scan_code
